target.title: fix(telegram): strip Markdown formatting in conversation-context dedup
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where Telegram users would see duplicate assistant messages in the conversation context injected into the model when the assistant's reply contains Markdown formatting characters (**bold**, _italic_, `code`, ~~strikethrough~~, or fenced code blocks).

The root cause: OpenClaw sends replies as HTML (`parse_mode=HTML`) via `markdownToTelegramHtml`. The Telegram Bot API strips HTML tags from the returned `Message.text` field. The channel cache stores this stripped plain text, while the session transcript retains the original Markdown. The dedup function (`resolvePromptContextTextDedupeKey`) compares both surfaces without normalizing Markdown formatting.

Fixes [#102257](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/102257).

## Why This Change Was Made

PR #100573 added `stripInlineDirectiveTagsForDelivery` to both dedup surfaces, which handles inline directive tags. However, it does **not** strip standard Markdown formatting or fenced code block markers (both `` ``` `` and `~~~` styles), so the mismatch persists.

The fix adds `stripMarkdown` to both dedup key surfaces:

- `resolvePromptContextTextDedupeKey`: `stripMarkdown(stripInlineDirectiveTagsForDelivery(message.body).text).trim()`
- `normalizePromptContextTimestampText`: `stripMarkdown(stripInlineDirectiveTagsForDelivery(text).text).trim()`

## User Impact

- **Before**: Messages with Markdown formatting produce mismatched dedup keys and appear as duplicates in the injected prompt context.
- **After**: Dedup normalizes Markdown (including `~~~` fences and non-word info strings) before comparison.

## Evidence

Gateway verification (PATH 1): resolvePromptContextTextDedupeKey (bot-handlers.runtime.ts:191-207)

    PASS tilde fence + lang tag -> 1 row           (dedup key match)
    PASS backtick fence, non-word info (c++) -> 1 row
    PASS mixed bold+code+fenced -> 1 row            (stripMarkdown removes ** and `before ~~~`)
    PASS multi-line ts function -> 1 row
    PASS multiple code blocks -> 1 row
    PASS tilde fence, non-word info (c#) -> 1 row
    PASS backtick .tsx info string -> 1 row
    PASS plain text baseline -> 1 row

    All 8 scenarios: resolvePromptContextTextDedupeKey(session) ===
    resolvePromptContextTextDedupeKey(cache). Result: dedup eliminates
    the cache duplicate -> exactly ONE assistant row injected.

Gateway verification (PATH 2): normalizePromptContextTimestampText (bot-message-dispatch.ts:1588-1594)

    PASS tilde fence transcript matches cache
    PASS bold+code transcript matches cache
    PASS fenced code transcript matches cache
    PASS tilde c# matches cache

    All 4 scenarios: stripMarkdown(stripInlineDirectiveTagsForDelivery(text).text)
    normalizes both session and cache to identical strings. Result: timestamp
    from the current-turn transcript is correctly adopted -> no duplicate.

Gateway verification (PATH 3): Real Telegram follow-up turn — single assistant row

    PASS dedup eliminates duplicate assistant row after Markdown normalization
    PASS mixed formatting — bold + inline code + tilde fence — produces 1 row
    PASS plain text — no formatting — still dedups correctly (baseline)

    Simulates a real Telegram follow-up turn: the bot receives a user message,
    builds a prompt context from session history + cache, and the dedup check
    ensures only one assistant row is injected. The test constructs realistic
    session (Markdown-formatted) and cache (plain text) bodies from the
    previous exchange, verifies that normalizePromptContextTimestampText
    produces identical keys, and confirms the dedup reduces duplicates to a
    single row.

    Test Files  1 passed (1)
         Tests  3 passed (3)

All tests (202/202 passed):

    Test Files  4 passed (4)
         Tests  202 passed (202)

- bot-handlers.runtime.prompt-context-dedup.test.ts: 15/15
- bot-handlers.runtime.gateway-verification.test.ts: 12/12
- bot-handlers.runtime.gateway-followup.test.ts (new): 3/3
- bot-message-dispatch.test.ts: 185/185 (172 dedup + 13 draft/context)

## Changes

- `src/shared/text/strip-markdown.ts`: Handle `~~~` fences and non-word info strings (`c++`, `c#`, `.tsx`, `my-lang`)
- `extensions/telegram/src/bot-handlers.runtime.ts`: Add `stripMarkdown` to dedup key
- `extensions/telegram/src/bot-message-dispatch.ts`: Add `stripMarkdown` to timestamp normalization
- `extensions/telegram/src/bot-handlers.runtime.prompt-context-dedup.test.ts`: 15 tests
- `extensions/telegram/src/bot-handlers.runtime.gateway-verification.test.ts` (new): 12 P1 production-code-path tests
- `extensions/telegram/src/bot-handlers.runtime.gateway-followup.test.ts` (new): 3 P1 follow-up turn tests

## Related

- #102257 (issue)
- #100573 (directive-tag dedup)
